does_not_apply.A1_A2: always-on arms have no regime-driven switching to govern; their only fills are strategy-native and fold_force_flat
does_not_apply.B: arm B runs ORIGINAL V2 mechanics by design (attrition included) so the engine-equivalence gate stays meaningful
does_not_apply.F: arm F inherits arm C's routing machinery and therefore this law automatically (seed paths routed as C is routed)

authority.freeze_order_law: this law freezes BEFORE any candidate PnL is computed

invariants.fill_cause_exclusive: every fill carries exactly one cause tag; a fill with zero or two tags is a ledger bug (hard failure)
invariants.fold_force_flat_not_a_switch: fold force-flat closes are tagged fold_force_flat and excluded from position_switch_count
invariants.switch_count_sanity: position_switch_count <= regime_switch_count + strategy_native_entries is NOT asserted (strategy-native churn is legal); the SEPARATE fields exist precisely so the auditor can compare them
invariants.zero_unnecessary_close_reopen: counter == 0 on every arm x cell x tier, else TURNOVER_LAW_VIOLATION

laws.law: the persisted-regime machine (confirm 2 / dwell 6 / cooldown 3, pinned constants above) is the first gate and is UNCHANGED; nothing in this freeze may relax it
laws.machine_check: constants equal safety_persistence_contract.persistence_params; any divergence is a freeze violation

laws.law: a persisted-regime switch changes the TARGET only after k = 1 further regime bar of confirmation (transition_buffer_regime_bars = 1); entries into a fresh episode become targetable only after the buffer completes
laws.not_selectable: 2-bar and 3-bar buffers are Phase-1 attribution diagnostics ONLY; they are never selectable in any scored arm

laws.law: minimum dwell of the target state is 6 regime bars (the machine's min_dwell); a specialist may impose a LONGER frozen min-hold in the library, never shorter; no scored path may exit a target state earlier than max(machine min_dwell, specialist frozen min-hold)

if the target direction equals the current position direction there is NO fill of any kind, even if the regime label or the selected specialist identity changed; a specialist switch takes effect ONLY at flat or at a direction change; mid-position specialist parameter changes are forbidden
laws.machine_check: fixture: label change with unchanged target direction must produce zero fills

unnecessary_close_reopen.definition: a close immediately followed by a reopen of the SAME direction with no strategy-native reason
unnecessary_close_reopen.law: must NEVER fire under this freeze; the counter existing > 0 on any arm x cell x tier is a hard TURNOVER_LAW_VIOLATION of that run (evaluation TECHABORT ladder), never a warning

laws.law: long->short and short->long reversals are an explicit close + open; BOTH sides' costs are charged (SPY is long-only, so its only reversals are flat transitions: each close and each open is charged individually)
laws.machine_check: reversal fills carry exactly two cost entries; assertion in the ledger test

laws.law: regime switches and actual position switches are reported as SEPARATE fields in every artifact; every fill carries exactly one cause tag
laws.position_switch_count_definition: count of direction-establishing fills: entries (flat -> position) plus reversals (position -> opposite position); pure exits and fold force-flat closes are NOT position switches

laws.binding: frozen BEFORE scoring; a FAIL here feeds the evaluation freeze's NO_REGIME_STRATEGY_INCREMENTAL_VALUE ladder for that cell
laws.law: arm C FAILS the cell if its position_switch_count at tier 1.0x >= the pinned V2 JEV_ONLY trade count on that cell (churn law not binding => the mechanism is not what it claims); additionally any candidate that is net-positive ONLY at zero cost (net > 0 at 0x but net <= 0 at 1.0x) FAILS the cell outright

v2_trade_count_pins.arbitration_note_for_A1: if the pinned V2 definition is round-trip- or exit-based rather than entry-based, A1 records the exact mapping to position_switch_count here pre-outcome; the law (C count >= pinned count => FAIL) is unchanged
v2_trade_count_pins.law: A1 pins, per cell, the V2 JEV_ONLY tier-1 trade count AND the V2 ledger field/definition it comes from (with artifact digest), so the comparison is apples-to-apples; A6 does not read outcome data
